parameters.name: DataQualityScanId
parameters.description: The ID of the data quality monitor.

parameters.description: The parameter settings used during the actual run. The `triggerTime` parameter is required.

parameters.description: The scheduling resource group used when running the data quality monitor. This resource group uses the same data structure as in the scheduling API.
